acts.title: Act I: The Threshold
acts.studyTakeaway: Establish immediate authority through atmosphere. If you bend perception in the first 60 seconds, the audience surrenders to the pace.
acts.bit: Super Puff materializes through analog CRT static, reaching into mid-air to twist an invisible dial that drops the venue room tone into a heavy 432Hz sub-bass hum.
acts.gag: The venue walls glitch and dissolve outward, revealing a boundless starry void while the mic stand floats in mid-air.
acts.audio: Analog static tear, deep 808 sub-drop (432Hz resonance), transition into lo-fi vinyl groove.
acts.visuals: CRT scanlines peeling back to 4K anime styling, neon aqua highlights, glassmorphism overlays.
acts.performanceScript: Welcome to the baseline. Secure your seatbelts, family—we are skipping the warm-up entirely. Running on 54-minute hours, 26.66-hour cycles.

acts.title: Act II: The Deep Tuning
acts.studyTakeaway: Push observational comedy into temporal absurdism.
acts.bit: Super Puff breaks down the sheer absurdity of linear 60-minute time and everyday corporate schedules.
acts.gag: Background stage elements melt and morph into chromatic fluid.
acts.audio: Binaural spatial audio shifts, 16-step synth pulses, pitch-shifted reverb echoes.
acts.visuals: Chromatic aberration ripples, liquid metal surfaces.
acts.performanceScript: Let us talk about the microwave trap. Forty-five seconds feels like a four-year university degree.

acts.title: Act III: Jikan Gire (Outro)
acts.comedyTheory: The Antidotal Mic Drop & Negative Space Exit
acts.studyTakeaway: The greatest comedians leave the room wanting 5 more minutes.
acts.bit: Super Puff drops the liquid chrome mic, takes one last monstrous rip from the cosmic bong.
acts.gag: The entire animated set gets swallowed by a massive cloud of thick violet smoke.
acts.audio: Low-pass reverb tail, bubbling bong water SFX, vinyl crackle fade out.
acts.visuals: Volumetric violet smoke, liquid chrome physics collapse, glowing neon kanji dissipation.
acts.performanceScript: じゃあな、良い夢見ろよ. Super Puff is out. Times Up, Mother Fathers.
